text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Today... Today is the day of a 
very important race!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Let's go to Tokyo Racecourse. I'll bring 
along the cheering flags, yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Japanese Derby. Today is the day Air 
Shakur, having claimed the Satsuki Sho, 
races for the Double Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to the buzz, she's the 
overwhelming first favorite. Her chances 
of winning seem exceedingly high, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, Shakur-san has been repeating it 
like she's having a nightmare. Over and 
over... 'Just 7cm, 7cm'..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
7 cm... What it meant remained a mystery. 
Amidst the swelling excitement, the race 
was underway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The final straight! Air Shakur breaks 
away! But the pack is hot on her heels! 
It's close, neck and neck!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Goal! It's too close to call! Will it be 
the pursuer's dream, or Air Shakur's raw 
tenacity?! Which one is it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A long, grueling photo finish. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Shakur-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Today, well, um... How should I put it... 
It was so close...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I know Shakur-san is definitely... 
definitely... better...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuuu...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk, told ya so.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I told you. Seven centimeters.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I knew it all along. No matter how I 
stacked the calculations, it fell short. 
Those last 7 centimeters before the goal, 
no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I didn't give up, but this is how it 
turned out. That's "data" for ya. Damn it 
all...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Numerical data... Then Shakur-san must 
be...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
'Course I saw it comin'. That's why I 
ain't down in the dumps. I've been 
preparin' for this all along.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she couldn't overturn it. That 
final nose margin was simply 
insurmountable.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: My first challenge ends here. Next time—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's your turn, Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? I-Is it my turn...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, living with you made me realize it, 
whether I liked it or not. Unlike me, 
you're just a bundle of erratic random 
variables.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe, if ya make use of all the 
yammerin' we've done so far, a miracle 
just might happen.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Up until now... So everything Shakur-san 
told me was...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk, don't get the wrong idea.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I just want to make God... or those Three 
Goddesses, roll the dice. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... it ain't gonna be easy. How're 
you plannin' to take on them raw stats?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Grit and smarts ain't gonna cut it. If my 
measurements are right, you're...
